## 📊 Service telemetry
Live users, activity, latency, errors and logs — from this project's Application Insights. Set the time range below. Reusable across any project in the subscription: deploy this same workbook bound to that project's Application Insights (its `sourceId` scopes every query, so nothing here is app-specific).

content.query:
requests
| summarize Requests=count(), Failed=countif(success == false), Users=dcount(user_Id), Sessions=dcount(session_Id), P95ms=round(percentile(duration, 95),0)
| extend ['Error %']=round(100.0 * Failed / todouble(Requests), 2)
| project Requests, ['Error %'], Users, Sessions, P95ms

requests
| summarize Total=count(), Failed=countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| extend Succeeded = Total - Failed
| project timestamp, Succeeded, Failed
| render timechart
content.title: Request volume (succeeded vs failed)

content.query:
requests
| summarize p50=percentile(duration,50), p95=percentile(duration,95), p99=percentile(duration,99) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Latency percentiles (ms)

content.query:
requests
| summarize Count=count(), ['Avg ms']=round(avg(duration),0), ['P95 ms']=round(percentile(duration,95),0), ['Error %']=round(100.0*countif(success==false)/count(),2) by Operation=name
| order by Count desc
| take 20
content.title: Top operations

content.query:
exceptions
| summarize Count=count() by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Exceptions over time

content.query:
exceptions
| summarize Count=count(), ['Last seen']=max(timestamp) by Problem=type, Message=tostring(outerMessage)
| order by Count desc
| take 30
content.title: Top exceptions

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
  (traces | where severityLevel >= 2 | project timestamp, kind='trace', level=tostring(severityLevel), operation=operation_Name, message),
  (exceptions | project timestamp, kind='exception', level='error', operation=operation_Name, message=strcat(type, ': ', tostring(outerMessage)))
| order by timestamp desc
| take 100
content.title: Recent logs (warnings, errors, exceptions)
